hints.title: Distinct Three Element Cascade
hints.text: Finding the third distinct maximum requires tracking the top three unique values while ignoring any duplicate encounters.

hints.title: Cascade Variable Invariant
hints.text: Three variables holding the first, second, and third highest values can be updated sequentially during a single pass through the array.

hints.title: Cascade Downward Shift Procedure
hints.text: Initialize three variables to null or negative infinity. For each number, ignore it if it equals one of the three candidates. Update first, second, or third accordingly by shifting existing values downward. Return the third candidate if found; otherwise return the maximum candidate.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Deduplicating with sets and sorting takes O(N log N) time and allocates heap memory for large input lists.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking three variables during a single linear scan achieves O(N) time and true O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle inputs with fewer than three distinct values and handle negative integers or integer minimum bounds gracefully.
